summary: The compositing system that blends layers and manages scrolling received fixes and improvements across device interactions, with particular attention to gesture-based scrolling, touch handling, and Metal GPU synchronization on macOS. Several patches addressed positioning of sticky and fixed elements, particularly with Firefox's new Nova browser design, and improvements to how hardware-decoded video HDR metadata flows to the compositor so colors display correctly. Performance was improved by batching compositor scroll updates and optimizing GPU fence synchronization.
